adaptive_disclosure: Final targeted combination search over four already-researched sleeves. This is adaptive research on touched 2018-2024 and cannot create clean OOS evidence.

development.rank: Higher CAGR, then higher Sharpe, then less severe percent DD, then canonical weight string.

shared_book_contract.gross_return: Back out each source's embedded trade and borrow costs, apply fixed weights to prior shared equity, then charge shared costs once.
shared_book_contract.gross_exposure: Additive sleeve gross with no cross-sleeve netting credit.
shared_book_contract.financing_rule: Charge max(additive gross - 1, 0) once per day.
shared_book_contract.ticker_concentration: Gross up each source ticker ledger by reversing embedded daily costs pro rata to absolute ticker contribution; allocate shared costs pro rata to absolute combined ticker gross PnL. Zero-gross days assign cost to SPY.

stopping_rule: This is the final static-weight combination grid on the touched sample. Do not refine weights after validation. If the selected row does not improve the rank-2 combo's return/DD trade-off and pass validation gates, stop combination mining.
post_run_reporting_addition: Before final reporting, the already-selected row was also replayed continuously over full touched 2018-2024. This descriptive row changes no grid metric, gate, ranking, selected weights, or validation decision; the script was re-hashed and outputs were overwritten.
